caption:
Fewer people are filing for new jobless benefits. More are staying on them. 👀
In mid-November, new claims were 203,000, but continuing claims hit 1.76 million, the highest since late August.
The unemployment rate is still 4.1%.
Has finding work felt easier or harder where you live?
